credibilityEvidence: Section 2 formal model (generators/guards/monitors) with Theorem 1 full proof via halting problem/Rice theorem reduction

candidates.title: MemOnce: A Scalable Memory Architecture for Large Language Models
candidates.institution: Nanjing University + University of Science and Technology of China
communitySignals: Also in today arXiv cs.CL new-submission batch (cross-source)
credibilityEvidence: Section 4 Experiments: 4 tracks (foundational capability, long-context memory, general capability retention, representation tasks) across WikiText/LAMBADA/LM-Eval-Harness/MemBench/LoCoMo/LongMemEval/PersonaMem/MMLU/GSM8K/GPQA
Table 2: from-scratch pretraining vs Transformer/YOCO/LastKV/SWA/GDN/MLA/Memory Caching at 0.15B-1B scale, 8xH100
Table 3-5: 2B/4B post-training adaptation vs full-context baseline and native-memory baselines (M+, EvoEmbedding, Metis, delta-Mem)
Section 5.2 Limitations: explicit disclosure that scale is capped at 1B and downstream agent-task validation is pending
candidates.evidenceMaturityReason: 在測試規模內（0.15B-1B 從頭訓練、2B/4B 後訓練適配）證據完整且有多基線對照，但未驗證 7B 以上規模與真實 agent 下游任務
reproducibilityEvidence: 正文列出訓練設定與超參數，未見明確程式碼/權重公開聲明
candidates.editorialConfidenceReason: 效能數字具體且多基線支持，但規模上限與 LLM 裁判一致性未報告
candidates.primaryLimitation: 從頭訓練只驗證到 1B 參數，長上下文記憶測試用 LLM（DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash）當裁判評分未報告與人工標註的一致性
candidates.hiddenAssumption: 假設作為長上下文記憶測試的「嚴格裁判」LLM（DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash）能準確判斷回答正確性，論文未報告此裁判與人工標註的一致性數據
candidates.hiddenAssumptionImpact: 若裁判系統性偏向某些回答風格而非事實正確性，Table 3-5 的效能數字可能高估或低估各方法的真實差距，但跨多基準多基線的相對排序模式仍有一定穩健性
candidates.presentationReason: 方法、實驗設定、基線選擇、限制邊界敘述清楚，表格數字可逐一回查
candidates.reason: SELECTED — 記憶/能力角度代表：四條評測軸、多基線、從頭訓練到後訓練適配皆覆蓋，4B 規模下擊敗全上下文基準，是今日證據密度最高的方法論文
